entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-08
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • NullableWalker assert failure with a collection expression passed to params collection #81552
    18.3
  • Incorrect optimization: a faulty load could be eliminated when compiling C# to IL #81574
  • Switch the BuildHost to use System.Text.Json #71020
    Backlog
  • Delegate conversion for extension methods contain wrong type error messages when omitting type arguments #16041
    Backlog
  • "Go to definition" goes to incorrect function in SourceLinks/disassembled sources #78533
  • Remove dependency on Newtonsoft.Json from Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces.MSBuild.BuildHost project #81561

Updated

  • Test plan for "Unsafe Evolution" #81207
    .NET 11
  • Honor BuildInParallel #81573
  • Fatal VS crash when invoking completion session #81576

PullRequests

Created

  • Initial support for Unions conversions #81586
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Unions
  • Unsafe evolution: handle unsafe methods and properties #81581
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution

Merged

  • NullableWalker.DebugVerifier: Explicitly visit `BoundCollectionExpressionSpreadElement.Conversion` #81584
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Merge branch 'main' into Unions #81585
    Area-Compilers, Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • SyntheticBoundNodeFactory: Remove ability to create arbitrary conversions #81569
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions, Next
  • Remove dependency on Newtonsoft.Json from Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces.MSBuild.BuildHost #81562
    VSCode, Next
  • Move 'Lightweight Overload Resolution' to shared location. #81582
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Improve go-to-def in situations where compiler returns multiple candidates. #81583
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Unsafe evolution: add `MemorySafetyRules` attribute #81441
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution

Updated

  • Fix CS1003 error message when expression follows identifier without '=' #81285
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Ref-safety for `with(...)` elements. #81542
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Dismiss and suppress gray text proposals for the duration of the event hookup session #81526
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Add PME override for manual builds #81362
  • Improve location of error diagnostic when encountering errant operator token #81295
    Area-Compilers
  • Move IDE code over to C# 14. #79835
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Improve order of returned items when overload resolution fails #81572
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Fix incorrect code generation on async iterators #81468
    Area-Compilers, Community, Feature - Async Streams
